description: This is a Java test class for the RunReportsApi, containing integration tests that verify report retrieval functionalities, including generating reports in various formats (JSON, PDF, CSV, Excel) and with different parameters. It tests the API endpoints by mocking server responses using WireMock and verifying the responses and headers.

classes.name: RunReportsApiIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for RunReportsApi, testing report retrieval APIs with different parameters and formats, using WireMock to mock server responses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WireMock server, configures the FineractFeignClient with the local server URL before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops the WireMock server after each test.

methods.name: testRunReportGetDataWithMultipleParameters
methods.description: Tests retrieving report data with multiple query parameters, expecting a JSON response with headers and data arrays.

methods.name: testRunReportGetDataWithEmptyResult
methods.description: Tests retrieving a report with no data returned, asserting empty headers and data lists.

methods.name: testRunReportGetFileAsPdf
methods.description: Tests fetching a report as a PDF file, verifying response headers and binary content.

methods.name: testRunReportGetFileAsCsv
methods.description: Tests fetching a report as a CSV file, verifying headers and content string.

methods.name: testRunReportGetFileAsExcel
methods.description: Tests fetching a report as an Excel (.XLS) file, verifying headers and binary content.

methods.name: testRunReportGetDataWithNoParameters
methods.description: Tests retrieving a report with no parameters, ensuring a successful response.
